verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no native sync or connector from Stripe Billing to QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or any general ledger or ERP. Revenue recognition automation (docs-7) is a different capability from GL sync. Webhooks (docs-16) are only a developer building block someone could use to build a sync, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a finance lead, invoices, payments, and recognition entries sync to my general ledger or ERP — QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite — so the close doesn't need CSV surgery
